The change that stopped the redundant query is commit `c21a7cbfa2c9f67c1991372a343217e949e04f44` ("TRUNK-6683: Skip full-text search with drugs when a concept is provided (#6346)", by Ian, 2026-07-17). The fix is in `HibernateConceptDAO.newDrugQuery`, which the service reaches through `ConceptServiceImpl.getDrugs`.

- **The fix:** the ConceptName full-text search now runs only when `searchDrugConceptNames && concept == null`, so a supplied concept skips it. The added comment says it skips "the relatively expensive concept-name full-text search" (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java:1582-1583`).
- **The service path:** `ConceptServiceImpl.getDrugs(drugName, concept, searchOnPhrase, searchDrugConceptNames, includeRetired, start, length)` delegates straight to `dao.getDrugs(...)` with no changes of its own (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/ConceptServiceImpl.java:1579-1581`).
- **Tests added in the same commit:** `getDrugs_shouldNotSearchConceptNamesWhenConceptIsSupplied` and `getDrugs_shouldSearchConceptNamesWhenNoConceptIsSupplied` in `HibernateConceptDAOTest.java`. They are backed by a new concept 20 ("ZEBRACONCEPT") with drug "Placebo-X" added to `HibernateConceptTestDataSet.xml`. I did not open these files at HEAD, so I'm citing them from the commit diff only.

The fix covers only the concept-supplied case. When no concept is given, the concept-name search still runs, as the second test checks.
